blocking_findings.finding: The22 new Q1/N runs can supply uninstrumented Q1-versus-N timings, but the reused Dense reference comes from tensor capture. Call57 the reference/quality-chain base maximum, not a full-three-arm Dense-speed maximum. If full DEV11 Dense production timing is later claimed, separately budget missing plain runs and any technical repeats. Do not silently count capture timings as production.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The v4 plan correctly requires per-source aggregation but does not yet pin one exact overall relative-MSE formula. Mean source-relative change and ratio of mean absolute errors can differ, as the old R1 results showed.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: Before V4 fitting/readout, state the source/expert/site aggregation and denominators in the finite analysis spec, preserve absolute MSE and both relative summaries, and do not choose whichever average favors the candidate. No extra samples or review bureaucracy are required to do this.

limitations: Only read-only file/metadata validation and arithmetic were performed; no inference, tensor capture, fit or benchmark metric was run.
Image payload bytes, image content, archive availability and true cluster independence were not reverified and are not asserted.
Historical G0 counts are user-reported; the full G0 bundle was not independently read in this review.
This review does not establish population-wide generalization, per-category statistical power, or empirical candidate superiority.
Approval requires a targeted re-read after the single blocking budget/measurement-scope clarification; do not enlarge the default experiment to satisfy the review.
